  layout $Closure$lambda2 size=24 align=8 refs=[]
  layout $Closure$lambda3 value size=8 align=8 refs=[0]
  layout $Closure$lambda3 size=32 align=8 refs=[24]
  layout $Closure$lambda4 value size=8 align=8 refs=[0]
  layout $Closure$lambda4 size=32 align=8 refs=[]
  layout $Closure$lambda5 value size=8 align=8 refs=[0]
  layout $Closure$lambda5 size=24 align=8 refs=[]
  layout $Closure$dynamic_adapter$(Local) -> Any value size=8 align=8 refs=[0]
  layout $Closure$dynamic_adapter$(Local) -> Any size=32 align=8 refs=[24]
  layout $Closure$dynamic_adapter$(Int) -> Any value size=8 align=8 refs=[0]
  layout $Closure$dynamic_adapter$(Int) -> Any size=32 align=8 refs=[24]
  layout $Closure$dynamic_adapter$(Unit) -> Any value size=8 align=8 refs=[0]
  layout $Closure$dynamic_adapter$(Unit) -> Any size=32 align=8 refs=[24]
  output library
